text.tspan: Use of interpolation and extrapolation on original Gini coefficient data

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: In order to produce global estimates of historical poverty trends we have interpolated or extrapolated inequality data for
missing observations. Green indicates observations of the Gini coefficient available in the original source.
